## LogSanitizer

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.Logging.LogSanitizer</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution.Sdk/Logging/LogSanitizer.cs:10](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution.Sdk/Logging/LogSanitizer.cs#L10).

Neutralizes client-controlled strings before they reach log templates: control characters (including CR/LF) are replaced with _ so forged input cannot fabricate or split log records, and unbounded values are truncated. Use for any caller-supplied value (symbols, actors, reasons, metadata) flowing into a log call; server-generated identifiers do not need it.

## BracketOrderMetadata

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Execution.Sdk.BracketOrderMetadata</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Execution.Sdk/BracketOrderMetadata.cs:13](../../../../src/Meridian.Execution.Sdk/BracketOrderMetadata.cs#L13).

Reads the bracket/OCO child-limb prices — the take-profit limit, the stop-loss trigger, and the optional stop-loss limit — from order metadata, using the same key aliases, precedence, and parse rules AlpacaBrokerageGateway.BuildOrderPayload routes them with (kept in step the way BrokerNotionalMetadata is with the notional keys). A pre-trade control that gates these limbs must read them from the same place the gateway does, or the gate measures one bracket while the broker works another.
